description: Remove public signup and add initial setup flow - when no users exist, prompt for seed user creation

userStories.title: Create helper to check if users exist
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a server-side helper to check if any users exist in the database.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/lib/server/users.ts with hasUsers(): boolean function
Function queries SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user and returns true if count > 0
Uses better-sqlite3 with DATABASE_PATH from environment (same pattern as src/lib/auth.ts)
Typecheck passes (npm run check)

userStories.title: Disable signup in better-auth configuration
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to disable the signup API endpoint so that unauthorized users cannot create accounts.
acceptanceCriteria: Modify better-auth configuration in src/lib/auth.ts to disable email signup
Set emailAndPassword.enabled to false OR use signUp.disabled option
POST to /api/auth/sign-up/email should no longer create users
Typecheck passes (npm run check)

userStories.title: Remove signup route and page
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to remove the signup page so that users cannot access the registration form.
acceptanceCriteria: Delete src/routes/auth/signup/+page.svelte
Delete src/routes/auth/signup directory if empty
Navigating to /auth/signup should return 404
Typecheck passes (npm run check)

userStories.title: Remove signup links from login page
userStories.description: As a user, I should not see Sign up links on the login page since registration is disabled.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove the paragraph with 'Don't have an account? Sign up' link from src/routes/auth/login/+page.svelte (around line 78-80)
Login page renders without any references to signup
Typecheck passes (npm run check)
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Create setup page UI
userStories.description: As an admin, I want to see a setup page on first visit so I can create my account.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/routes/setup/+page.svelte with form fields: name, email, password, confirmPassword
Reuse auth styling patterns (.auth-container, .auth-card) from login page
Title: 'Initial Setup' with subtitle 'Create your admin account'
Client-side validation: name required, valid email format, password min 8 chars, passwords must match
Show error messages for validation failures
Submit button shows loading state while submitting
Typecheck passes (npm run check)
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Create setup page server logic
userStories.description: As a developer, I want server-side logic to handle initial user creation securely.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/routes/setup/+page.server.ts with load function and actions
load function: use hasUsers() helper; if users exist, redirect to /auth/login
actions.default: validate input, create user using better-auth API or direct DB insert with hashed password
After successful user creation, redirect to /auth/login with success message or auto-login
If users already exist when form is submitted, return error (prevent race condition)
Typecheck passes (npm run check)

userStories.title: Redirect to setup when no users exist
userStories.description: As a user visiting the app for the first time, I should be redirected to setup if no users exist.
acceptanceCriteria: Modify src/hooks.server.ts to import and use hasUsers() helper
If no users exist and path is /auth/login, redirect 302 to /setup
If no users exist and path is /setup, allow access (no redirect)
If users exist and path is /setup, redirect 302 to /auth/login
Existing /app protection logic remains unchanged
Typecheck passes (npm run check)
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill: fresh DB redirects to setup; after user exists, /setup redirects to login

userStories.title: Update documentation
userStories.description: As a user reading the README, I should understand the new setup flow.
acceptanceCriteria: Update README.md Development section to mention initial setup creates admin account
Remove or update any references to 'signup' in README.md
Add note that first visit after fresh install prompts for admin account creation
Typecheck passes (npm run check)
